name: jest-runs-the-files-its-roots-and-test-match-name
description: Jest runs the files below each of its roots that its testMatch globs match over the whole path, read from a CommonJS configuration file as Node leaves its module value. Each such file is a test file in a JavaScript package with no compiler configuration, so a function only those tests call is reported as test-only use, while a file the globs match outside the roots is a file nothing loads. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named jest for the package jest whose range holds the installed version.
